title: Split tools.test.ts slice 4 — chat/activity/cross-cutting, then delete tools.test.ts
description:
Slice 4 of 4 — the closer — splitting packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/tools.test.ts (3147 lines, 32 describe blocks). Sliced because the plan-size gate caps a plan at 10 distinct affectedFiles and the full split needs ~30 destination files — human-approved split decision, 2026-07-31.

DEPENDS ON SLICES 1, 2 AND 3 (task-4f541baba99b458da14bf8250d88af4c, task-a1e3148993f7413a900a44dce9429beb, task-9cf38eb411b640c5a528866f9dc58a3b). First planned step must confirm src/tools/__fixtures__/toolsHarness.ts exists AND that tools.test.ts contains only the 5 describe blocks below; if other describes remain, an earlier slice has not landed — call moe.report_blocked rather than absorbing its scope.

Move the remaining describe blocks, verbatim, no assertion changes:
- 'moe.get_activity_log' -> getActivityLog.test.ts (NEW)
- 'Task comments' -> addComment.test.ts (APPEND — file exists)
- 'WIP limits' -> lifecycleFixes.test.ts (APPEND)
- 'ARCHIVED status' -> lifecycleFixes.test.ts (APPEND)
- 'Task timestamps' -> lifecycleFixes.test.ts (APPEND)
- 'chat token budgets' -> split across chatRead.test.ts / chatSend.test.ts (both NEW) by which tool each `it` exercises; if the block is genuinely cross-tool, put it in one new chatTokenBudgets.test.ts instead — this slice has spare file slots, so pick whichever keeps the assertions intact.

Then DELETE tools.test.ts. The three cross-cutting blocks (WIP limits, ARCHIVED status, Task timestamps) are not per-tool and belong in lifecycleFixes.test.ts, which already holds lifecycle-level coverage — that is the intended home, not a new file.
definitionOfDone: all remaining describe blocks running under their destination file, cross-cutting ones in lifecycleFixes.test.ts
vitest total test count for the whole daemon suite identical to the pre-split baseline recorded in slice 1 (no test lost across all four slices)
npx tsc --noEmit clean and full suite green with zero new failures vs. the pre-slice baseline
